description: The Nexees design tokens: the one source of the colours, text sizes, spacing and control sizes of both clients (R18, R19). Colours are #rrggbb and come from the approved compact layout, assets/design/desktop/approved-compact-layout.png. Every other value is a whole number of density-independent pixels: CSS pixels on Desktop, dp on Android (sp for text). scripts/build/design_tokens.py checks this file, with the contrast every text colour must keep, and writes each client's copy.
